info.description: Source element for World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: World of Warcraft by Andrey Kuzinskiy: a fan-made Dungeons & Dragons sourcebook that brings Azeroth to the fifth edition (2024) rules. It adds World of Warcraft classes built on the Player’s Handbook (2024) classes, seventeen playable species, professions and gear, faction renown and new spells.
This content requires the Player’s Handbook (2024) from Aurora Legacy. World of Warcraft is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment; this is an unofficial fan conversion.
